treatments.label: Condition-Based Inspection Cadence
treatments.description: Replace fixed-interval inspection with risk- and condition-based scheduling so the worst assets are assessed most often and inspection budgets follow actual deterioration.

companies.name: Bentley Systems
companies.functional_reason: Maintains digital-twin condition memory of infrastructure assets, consolidating history into lifecycle and whole-life-cost decisions

companies.name: AECOM
companies.functional_reason: Performs condition assessment and asset-management planning, retaining the service-life record that drives deferred-maintenance decisions

companies.name: Trimble
companies.functional_reason: Captures and stores field condition data for pavements and structures, building the durable asset memory predictive maintenance depends on

activations.domainDescription: Cross-asset, inter-modal dependency monitoring that detects how a failure in one infrastructure system propagates into others — road closures into transit demand, water-main breaks into ground instability threatening bridges.
activations.domainFunction: Integrates signals across transport, water, grid, and structural systems to detect and forecast cascading failures, correlating real-time stress so a single-system event is caught before it propagates network-wide.
activations.whyThisNode: The angular gyrus is a multimodal convergence hub that binds inputs from separate sensory streams into a unified representation, mirroring how cascade detection fuses signals across distinct infrastructure modes to see system-level risk.
diagnosticTriggers: Road closure into transit reroute demand surge
Water main break into soil instability into bridge pier risk
Grid outage into water-pump and signal loss

treatments.label: Real-Time Intermodal Stress Correlation
treatments.description: Fuse live feeds from transport, water, grid, and structural sensors into a dependency model that flags when stress in one system is loading another, enabling intervention before a cascade completes.

treatments.label: Interdependency Mapping and Redundancy
treatments.description: Map the cross-asset dependency graph to locate single points of failure whose loss cascades, then add redundancy and isolation so a fault in one mode cannot bring down the others.

treatments.label: Cascade Scenario Stress Testing
treatments.description: Run coupled what-if simulations across infrastructure modes to quantify propagation paths and rank mitigation investments by the cascade risk they retire.

companies.name: Hexagon AB
companies.functional_reason: Integrates cross-asset sensor and geospatial data into a unified operational picture, binding inter-modal signals for cascade detection

companies.name: Bentley Systems
companies.functional_reason: Models interdependent infrastructure networks in digital twins, correlating cross-system stress to surface cascading-failure risk

companies.name: Esri (privately held)
companies.functional_reason: Fuses multimodal infrastructure layers geospatially, integrating dependency signals across transport, water, and grid

issues.label: Grid Failure
issues.summary: Cascading electrical grid failure resulting in widespread blackouts, disrupting all electricity-dependent systems including hospitals, water treatment, communications, and heating or cooling during extreme weather

_authored.detail: Electrical grid relay and distribution functions collapsed, severing power delivery to dependent systems
Telecommunications infrastructure failing as backup power exhausted, cutting communication during crisis
Data centers and digital infrastructure going offline, disrupting financial systems, government services, and internet access
Water treatment facilities unable to operate pumps and purification systems, threatening water safety
Emergency systems overwhelmed with cascading failures requiring simultaneous response across multiple infrastructure sectors

issues.label: Bridge Collapse
issues.summary: Catastrophic structural failure of critical bridge or tunnel infrastructure, severing transportation links, causing casualties, and revealing systemic neglect in infrastructure maintenance and inspection

_authored.detail: Critical crossing link severed, fragmenting transportation network and isolating connected communities
Road network massively overloaded as traffic reroutes through alternate corridors not designed for the volume
Building code inspection and monitoring systems revealed to have failed in detecting progressive structural deterioration
Construction industry mobilized for emergency demolition and accelerated replacement under intense time pressure
Public transit routes disrupted as bridge closure removes key links from bus and rail networks
Emergency response systems activated for rescue operations and public safety cordons around collapse site

issues.label: Water Crisis
issues.summary: Failure of water treatment or distribution infrastructure leading to contamination, supply shortages, or public health emergencies affecting large populations dependent on municipal water systems

_authored.detail: Water treatment and distribution homeostasis broken, delivering contaminated or insufficient water to populations
Water pipeline infrastructure leaking or blocked, with aging mains rupturing and distribution pressure falling
Wastewater systems backing up as treatment capacity fails, creating sewage overflow and environmental contamination
Emergency water distribution activated with bottled water, tanker trucks, and boil-water advisories issued
Water quality monitoring and regulatory oversight found to have missed contamination signals or deferred critical maintenance

issues.label: Telecom Outage
issues.summary: Major telecommunications infrastructure failure disrupting voice, data, and internet services across wide areas, isolating populations and disabling digital-dependent services including banking, navigation, and emergency communications

_authored.detail: Telecommunications transmission capacity lost, severing voice and data communication links across affected area
Cloud services, digital platforms, and internet-dependent applications inaccessible without network connectivity
Emergency 911 systems disrupted, preventing populations from reaching first responders during the outage
Urban planning and coordination functions disrupted as municipal agencies lose ability to communicate and coordinate
Public transit systems losing real-time scheduling, passenger information, and dispatch coordination capabilities

issues.label: Transit Breakdown
issues.summary: Systemic failure of public transit systems through mechanical breakdowns, labor strikes, funding crises, or ridership collapse, stranding commuters and exacerbating traffic congestion and social inequality

circuits.detail: primary motor cortex — motor output — weakness, paresis

_authored.detail: Routine transit service halted as trains and buses pulled from service due to mechanical failure or labor action
Road networks overwhelmed as displaced transit riders shift to personal vehicles, causing severe congestion
Rail system scheduling and coordination collapsed, with cascading delays and cancellations across the network
Transit planning and management capacity insufficient to develop and fund recovery plans for aged systems
Construction and maintenance workforce unable to keep pace with repair backlog on aging transit infrastructure
Air transport connections to transit hubs disrupted as passengers cannot reach airports via ground transit
